definitions.scope: rx3 restricts prescription baselines and condition effects to kyoku where LuckyJ is not dealer; dealer-only numbers are shown only as side-by-side diagnostics.
definitions.hypothesis_check_scope: All LuckyJ tsumo states with real_dahai and dahai_pred are counted before any push/fold filtering; dahai_pred[0] is treated as Nishiki head model.
definitions.nishiki_top_discard_match: top 34-tile index in state['dahai_pred'][0] equals real_dahai by 34-tile class.
definitions.danger: For LuckyJ's actual discard, max(state[danger_s/t/k][LuckyJ seat][tile_index] / 10000), reused from scripts/mine_rx2_defense.py.
definitions.closed_shanten: No own melds and not own riichi; shanten is mahjong.shanten over LuckyJ's current 14-tile hand. Buckets 0/1/2/3+.
definitions.vs_riichi_scope: States classified as single_riichi or riichi_plus_more by scripts/mine_rx2_defense.py classifier.
definitions.first_discard_after_riichi_genbutsu: For each opponent riichi declaration, LuckyJ's next tsumo discard is genbutsu if its tile index is in that riichi player's own river, including the declaration discard.
definitions.open_hand_scope: No-riichi states classified as 2_meld_opponent or 3plus_meld_opponent, using the selected max-open opponent and turn bucket.
definitions.condition_effect_delta: push_rate(condition value) - push_rate(all other values of that condition). significant=true only when value and complement both have n>=150 and |delta| exceeds the combined 95% CI half-width.
definitions.excluded_published_modifier: The published tenpai + LuckyJ-is-dealer ~=68% modifier is definitionally excluded from child-only prescriptions.

0.scope: child-only closed tenpai decisions while facing at least one riichi

1.scope: child-only closed 1-shanten decisions while facing at least one riichi

open_hand_turn7plus.scope: child-only no-riichi states classified as 2_meld_opponent or 3plus_meld_opponent, selected opponent turn >= 7
